title: HELIX Bridge: Canvas LMS Outcomes → LearningOutcome

source_objects.description: A learning outcome defined at the account (institution or program) or course level: title, description, mastery points, rating scale.
A student's result against an outcome through an aligned rubric, quiz, or assignment (Outcome Results API): score, percent, mastery, assessed date, alignment.
Folder structure of outcomes. Most schools use it to hold institutional, general education, and program outcomes.

notes: Canvas user IDs aren't institutional IDs. Resolve through the Canvas SIS user ID loaded from your SIS. Outcome results are education records. For accreditation reports, aggregate by outcome and program and suppress cells under N of 5. Watermark, Anthology, and D2L Brightspace hold the same data under different names.
validate: Field names follow the Canvas Outcomes and Outcome Results APIs. Confirm against your instance, and note that the newer Outcomes Service may be enabled.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from Outcome Result ID.

attribute_mappings.source: Outcome Result user -> SIS user ID

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve the program an account-level outcome belongs to, through a mapping of outcome groups to HELIX Program.

Institution account outcomes -> institutional_learning_outcome; general education group -> general_education_competency; program group -> program_learning_outcome; course-level -> course_learning_outcome; accreditor standard groups -> accreditation_standard or professional_competency.
For example AAC&U VALUE rubrics or an accreditor's standards.
Rubric -> rubric; quiz or exam -> exam; ePortfolio -> portfolio; capstone assignments -> capstone; else other.
